kind: cold-spot position uncertainty in a 2D section
conclusion: On the 24x16 grid 32 cells sit within 0.5 K of the minimum (8.3% of the field), so the cold spot is a plateau, not a point. The reported single depth is one representative of that plateau, and a probe aimed at it has an uncertainty of the plateau width. This is why the paper scores the cold-spot temperature (which the 1D kernel reproduces to 0.31 K) and does not score a cold-spot position: the position is genuinely ill-determined on the temperature evidence alone.
